title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Saturday, October 31, 2026. Happy Halloween! 🎃

🌤️ Weather
Sunny, dry and crisp. It starts in the 40s this morning and climbs to a high near 61°, with a low around 44° tonight. Close to 0% chance of rain.
What to wear/bring: a light jacket now, plus a warmer layer over your costume tonight. It cools off fast after sunset.

🗞️ Headlines
• Midterms are Tuesday. More than 43 million Americans have already voted early.
• The fights over ballots are heating up. An appeals court turned down a DOJ request to set aside disputed California ballots. The DOJ is also trying to set aside some Alaska ballots as part of a criminal probe.
• Wall Street had its worst day since June as the sell-off in tech and AI stocks got deeper.
• The US, South Korea and Japan put out a joint statement recommitting to a fully denuclearized Korean Peninsula.
• NYC: Marathon weekend is here. More than 50,000 runners race Sunday on a new route through the Bronx, and street closures start today.

🚇 Getting around
• Expect rolling street closures today for the Abbott Dash to the Finish Line 5K, plus marathon setup.
• Tonight Sixth Avenue closes in the Village for the parade, roughly from Canal/Spring St up to 16th St. Take the subway, not a car or cab.
• I couldn't find this weekend's MTA Weekender yet, so check mta.info before you ride.

🎉 NYC today
• The 53rd Village Halloween Parade starts at 7 PM on Sixth Ave, and this year's theme is "Body & Soul." It's free to watch, and anyone in costume can march.
• Tomorrow is the TCS NYC Marathon, with a new Bronx stretch this year. Pick a corner to cheer from.

💡 Nugget
Clocks fall back at 2 AM tonight, so you get an extra hour of sleep. 🕑 It's also a good time to test your smoke detector batteries. And in New York, Sunday is the last day of early voting before Tuesday.
